summary: File the shepherd example under the existing detransitive sense 2
rationale: The subject in 109/3 is the vizier himself: "kəzzele, gmirastəq ʕal ruʕyo". He comes upon a shepherd, rather than sending someone towards one. This matches the existing sense 2 "(Detrans.) geraden Weges gehen" and the detransitive Infectum examples "gmirastqo ʕal ruʕyo" and "gmirastqina ʕal ad dewe".
